text: Settings > Controls: keyboard Walk row says 'W A S D or arrow keys' and there is no Turn row, but Left/Right arrows turn (about 103 deg/s) rather than strafe. Panel header also still reads 'Options' while the Controls tab is selected.

Chapters on a fresh save: even the Prologue shows a lock and 'Reach it in the story to unlock'; menu subtitle says 'See the story ahead' but the panel is 'The story so far' and nothing ahead is visible (all names only, all locked). Also: on the title menu, the first click on Settings and the first click on Chapters both did nothing; the second identical click opened the panel (reproduced twice).

With About open, the focused 'Wake up' button turns orange but keeps light text: 'Wake up' and 'Start the story - about 20 minutes' are pale grey/white on orange, nearly unreadable (on first load it uses dark text). About text uses 'Schwarzschild solution' and 'one unit of black-hole time is 0.59 seconds' with no explanation; a teen would not know what a unit of black-hole time is.

Two Clocks lesson: clicking the '> Words used here' disclosure (at ~110,502 and ~80,502, three tries, 1-3 s waits) never expands it. The mission uses 'M' as a time unit ('a ping every 10 M') with no visible explanation, so the glossary is the only place a newcomer could learn it.

Two Clocks spacetime diagram: the 'now' and 'station' labels at the top-left (10 rs, time 0) are drawn on top of each other and unreadable. Also: input lag in lessons is severe on this loaded machine (load avg ~62): clicks and scrolls show up 10-30 s later, so my earlier 'glossary won't open' note was lag, not a bug (it did open).

Bend the Light works well: Aim slider to 2.51 rs = swallowed, 2.61 rs = 286 deg, Fine-tune -0.01 = 390 deg (around once); quiz 'About 2.6 times wider' marked Right with a clear debrief. Small issues: the diagram's 'edge: aim 2.598 rs' label sits on top of the laser marker and gives the quiz answer away; 'Each extra loop needs you to aim about 535 times closer' is unexplained for a newcomer.

Observatory 3D view shows 'The 3D view needs WebGL 2. This device does not support WebGL 2' (black panel), yet the title screen on the same session renders the ray-traced black hole fine. Reached via Title > Training > Two Clocks > Bend the Light > top-nav Observatory. Readouts still update (SHADOW SIZE 152 deg across, YOU ARE hovering). Probably a lost/exhausted WebGL context after several lesson pages rather than real lack of support; the message misleads the player.

Evaporation lesson: with the Mass slider far left the readout says '1e-20 suns' (computer exponent notation) while the explanation below uses 2x10^10 kg; a teen will not read '1e-20'. Otherwise the timeline and Great Pyramid comparison are clear.

Into the Dark (lesson 7) also shows 'The 3D view needs WebGL 2' after the GPU process crashed (chrome.log: 'GPU process exited unexpectedly' x3 at 10:06-10:11); title screen now shows a flat 2D fallback disc. There is no retry/reload hint; the lesson's main visual is gone for the rest of the session.
